description: This file is a header (*.h) file defining the NetworkManagerClient class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It declares methods for network interface management, Wi-Fi operations, and settings adjustments, along with includes and macro definitions relevant to network management tasks.

classes.name: NetworkManagerClient
classes.description: A singleton class providing methods to manage network interfaces and Wi-Fi configurations, including scanning, connecting, and retrieving network information.

methods.name: NetworkManagerClient * getInstance()
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the NetworkManagerClient.

methods.name: getAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available network interfaces.

methods.name: setPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Sets the specified interface as the primary.

methods.name: setInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables a specified network interface.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Configures IP settings for a given interface.

methods.name: getPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the primary network interface.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the default network interface.

methods.name: getInterfaceState
methods.description: Checks if a specified interface is enabled.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves IP configuration for an interface.

methods.name: getKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Lists stored Wi-Fi SSIDs.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Gets info of the currently connected Wi-Fi SSID.

methods.name: addToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds an SSID to the known list.

methods.name: removeKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Removes an SSID from the known list.

methods.name: startWifiScan
methods.description: Initiates a Wi-Fi scan.

methods.name: isWifiScannedRecently
methods.description: Checks if Wi-Fi scan was performed recently.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information for an interface.

methods.name: wifiConnect
methods.description: Connects to a Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: wifiDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from current Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: activateKnownConnection
methods.description: Activates a known Wi-Fi connection.

methods.name: getWifiState
methods.description: Retrieves the current Wi-Fi state.

methods.name: getWiFiSignalQuality
methods.description: Gets Wi-Fi signal quality metrics.

methods.name: startWPS
methods.description: Starts a WPS process.

methods.name: stopWPS
methods.description: Stops the WPS process.

methods.name: setHostname
methods.description: Sets the system hostname.

methods.name: modifyDefaultConnectionsConfig
methods.description: Modifies the default connections configuration.

methods.name: wpsProcess
methods.description: Internal method to handle WPS operations.

methods.name: getMatchingSSIDInfo
methods.description: Finds matching SSID info for WPS.

methods.name: isActiveApSameAsWps
methods.description: Checks if active AP matches WPS SSID.
